Butcher Hero Save Editor v47

Open your game_data.bin, change any value, and save it back. The integrity hash is recalculated for you. Everything runs in this page and your file is never uploaded.

Where to find game_data.bin — Android & iOS

Android: open your file manager and go to Internal storage > Android > data, then look for the Butcher Hero folder (named after the game) > files > game_data.bin. On Android 11 and later that folder is often blocked for normal file managers — if you cannot see it, use a file manager with Shizuku / ADB access, or a PC file transfer.

If you still cannot see it, the file lives in the game's private app storage (/data/data/…), which needs root or ADB access to reach.

iOS (iPhone / iPad): open the Files app > Browse > On My iPhone and look for the Butcher Hero folder > game_data.bin. If it is not there, connect your iPhone to a computer and use Finder (Mac) or iTunes / Apple Devices (Windows) > your iPhone > Files > Butcher Hero to copy it out. If the game syncs to iCloud, check iCloud Drive > Butcher Hero too.

After editing: close the game completely, back up the original game_data.bin, then put the edited file back in the same place with the exact same name.
